answer: An emission concentration levy taxes sybil yield: when one funding tree's payout crosses one percent of an epoch's emissions, everything above burns at eighty percent, and a second breach halves the cap. A 100-clone farm at ten percent of a 1,000,000 POA round surrenders 72,000 POA per settlement, while an honest identity at the nadir of the spread pays nothing. Levy tables sit on the mesa; a nebula of payouts on one wallet faces falling caps.
